# Openclipart CC0 curation evidence

Openclipart states that every upload is dedicated under CC0 1.0, may be used commercially and modified, and does not require attribution. The official CC0 1.0 legal text is bundled as `CC0-1.0-LEGALCODE.txt`. Each detail page is the source and per-item author/title/upload evidence.

The files in `source/` are downloaded upstream SVG originals, retained unmodified. The Studio catalog strips non-rendering XML/editor metadata when embedding artwork; visible vector drawing content is preserved.
